purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
summary: Montería is officially evidenced as a cadastral gestor, and the official IGAC national Dato Fundamental Catastro service exposes polygon cadastral layers with schema and EPSG:4686 confirmed. Bounded anonymous U_TERRENO geometry queries timed out after an initial pagination error; no parcel sample was retained. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: English and Spanish first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-2664-monter-a.json. They found the official IGAC service, Colombia en Mapas cadastral guidance and Montería municipal cadastral-manager evidence.
requestOutcomes: IGAC service and layer metadata returned successfully. An initial exact-point request was rejected because pagination is unsupported; a corrected exact-point request and a small envelope request timed out. Municipal publication retrieval returned 403 through the independent fetch path. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA bypass or unsafe-field request was made.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [8.74837101551563, -75.8807072805695] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No city boundary or complete Montería coverage was established for the open national service.
No parcel geometry or raw source-specific attribute set was retained.
The local cadastral-manager publication establishes custody, not a qualified public adapter.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was retained because no feature response was obtained. Candidate official fields are CODIGO and GLOBALID_S; a future sample must contain exactly one independently confirmed stable native identity in GeoJSON properties.
crs: EPSG:4686 verified from U_TERRENO layer metadata
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: Service schema is verified, but bounded response performance, parcel coverage for Montería, native identity stability and geometry availability remain unknown. Timeouts and 403 do not support a citywide-absence conclusion.
